people.text: Rashid would like to cook healthy meals for his children, and is looking for a course which teaches basic skills. He and his children enjoy eating dishes from around the world.
Angela's a good cook, and wants to make a special dinner for 20 guests at her husband's birthday party. She'd like to make more advanced dishes, and her husband particularly likes traditional food.
Marcus would like some ideas for meals for one person, without having to buy fresh ingredients every day. He wants quick and easy dishes he can cook when he gets home from work feeling hungry.
Francesca is an experienced cook who wants to get new ideas for meals for her family. She'd like to increase her range of skills in the kitchen and learn how to make tasty desserts.
Aston wants to spend time trying complicated recipes at the weekend because he finds it relaxing. He wants to make food in large amounts, so he can take a proper meal to work for lunch every day.

items.label: A
items.title: Food for you
items.text: If you often eat away from home and want some food you can take with you, you'll be interested in our recipes for snacks that are quick and easy to make. We'll show you how to create delicious healthy treats and sweets – great for young and old alike on family picnics.

items.label: B
items.title: Tasty treats
items.text: If you're just starting your journey to become a great cook, this course is for you! We'll teach you how to prepare food safely, and show you recipes for simple but tasty dishes from many different countries. People of all ages will enjoy these dishes, which are also very good for you.

items.label: C
items.title: Come and cook!
items.text: Whether you're cooking for yourself or for others, our simple but delicious meals don't take long to make – perfect for those with busy lives. We'll show you how to make the most of what you've probably already got in your kitchen cupboards. Satisfying meals without too much trouble!

items.label: D
items.title: Kerry's kitchen
items.text: This course is for less experienced cooks who want to create exciting meals. Perfect for special occasions or when you just fancy doing something different. Learn to create a meal from starter to dessert, and how to present it attractively for your dinner party guests. Our focus is on modern international dishes.

items.label: E
items.title: Delicious dishes
items.text: This course is for people who want to take their cookery skills to the next level. We focus on typical recipes – especially for main courses – passed down through generations from all over the country, to help you put together a fantastic meal for any occasion. We promise everyone will be impressed!

items.label: F
items.title: Eat well
items.text: Our main dishes and healthy desserts are challenging to prepare and cook, but they're definitely worth the effort. Once they're ready, there's enough for you to divide up into several one - meal portions. Then you can keep them for a few days in the fridge until you need them.

items.label: G
items.title: Food lovers
items.text: If you lead a busy life and don't particularly like making meals, come and find out how to feed family and friends simple food made from healthy, fresh ingredients. Our “picnic suppers” involve baking delicious breads and cakes which you can prepare in advance, then serve with salads and other cold dishes.

items.label: H
items.title: Hot stuff
items.text: You may consider yourself a bit of a chef, but there's always more to learn! Come on our course and we'll not only teach you advanced techniques but give you loads of interesting and unusual recipes – from soups to cakes and ice - cream – that even very young children will love.

explanations.6: Rashid 想为孩子做健康餐，找教基本技能的课程，喜欢世界各地菜肴。B 选项 “Tasty treats” 适合初学者，教安全备餐和各国简单美味食谱，符合需求。原文 “teach you how to prepare food safely... recipes for simple but tasty dishes from many different countries” 对应 “basic skills, world dishes, healthy meals”。
explanations.7: Angela 是好厨师，想为丈夫生日派对做 20 人特别晚餐，做高级菜肴，丈夫喜欢传统食物。E 选项 “Delicious dishes” 针对想提升厨艺的人，专注于代代相传的传统食谱，适合重要场合，符合需求。原文 “take their cookery skills to the next level... typical recipes passed down through generations... fantastic meal for any occasion” 对应 “advanced dishes, traditional food, special dinner”。
explanations.8: Marcus 想找一人餐食谱，不用每天买新鲜食材，下班饿了能快速做。C 选项 “Come and cook!” 教用厨房现有食材做简单美味餐，适合忙碌人士，符合需求。原文 “simple but delicious meals don't take long to make... make the most of what you've probably already got in your kitchen cupboards” 对应 “quick, easy, one person, no fresh ingredients daily”。
explanations.9: Francesca 是有经验的厨师，想为家人找新食谱，提升厨房技能，学做美味甜点。H 选项 “Hot stuff” 教高级技巧和不寻常食谱，包括汤、蛋糕和冰淇淋，适合有经验者，符合需求。原文 “teach you advanced techniques... interesting and unusual recipes – from soups to cakes and ice-cream” 对应 “new ideas, advanced skills, desserts”。
explanations.10: Aston 想周末尝试复杂食谱放松，做大份量食物，每天带午餐上班。F 选项 “Eat well” 主菜和甜点制作有挑战性但值得，做好后可分成多份放冰箱，符合需求。原文 “challenging to prepare... enough for you to divide up into several one-meal portions... keep them for a few days in the fridge” 对应 “complicated recipes, large amounts, take to work”。
